sentences.text: Heard Smt.S.Sreedevi, the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Smt.Sudha Devi, the learned Special Government Pleader (Revenue) for the respondents herein.

3. A statment has been filed on behalf of the 2 nd respondent dated 07.04.2025 pointing out as under:
"6.

As the awards were passed after the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 which came in force on 01.01.2014, another agreement as proposed in the Government order No.G.O. (Rt)3085/14/RD dated 05.07.2014 was also executed between the parties and the District Collector which provided for payment of amount found in excess of the compensation that has already been paid to the land owners when calculation of compensation is 2025:KER:42097 WP(C) NO. 7311 OF 2017 made as per the new Act.

entities.text: land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Based on representations filed by the petitioners before the Land Acquisition Officer on 30.11.2016 the District Collector has ordered to calculate compensation as per the provisions of the new Act.
Accordingly Basic valuation report as per the provisions of the new Act was being prepared.
It is at this point the petitioners have approached the Hon'ble Court."

4. In the light of the afore, I am of the opinion that this writ petition can be disposed of by directing the competent among the respondents to consider re-calculation of the compensation, if any, with reference to the provisions of the 2013 Act, within a time frame.

In the result, this writ petition will stand disposed of by directing the competent among the respondents to consider the re-calculation with reference to the provisions of 2013 Act, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
